A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Ready when you are.

Explore plans and pricing ↗
Do browsing plans include job adverts?+

No. Monthly and annual candidate-browsing plans do not include job postings unless purchased as an add-on.

Do subscriptions renew automatically?+

Monthly browsing subscriptions renew monthly and annual browsing subscriptions renew annually unless cancelled. Renewal settings can be managed in your account.

Is VAT included?+

VAT is applied where applicable and shown at checkout and on invoices. All prices are in GBP.

Can I close a job advert after hiring?+

Yes. You can close a job before its listing period ends once you have hired.

Is candidate verification required?+

No. Identity verification is optional. It costs £10 once per account and involves a passport upload. Creating a candidate account is free.
